title: core.event.v1 WalletStateChanged payload
description: A wallet's state as the core holds it (ticket 67, spec 18.7, D5): published on create, on every status change and in a snapshot of every wallet (dev, on start). version only grows for a wallet (also across a core reset); a consumer keeps the state of the highest version it saw and ignores an equal or lower one, so duplicates, snapshots and out-of-order delivery are harmless. Only wallets a person logs in to (with an MSISDN) are published, never system wallets.

walletType.description: ORGANISATION is the core's name of an organisation wallet since ticket 94 (FRS 7.1); ORG is the same type as earlier producers named it.

status.description: LOCKED = a core-side lock; BLOCKED and HOLD = compliance states; DORMANT = unused for long (cannot pay, can receive) and CLOSED = closed for good (FRS 7.1, ticket 94).

hasPin.description: Whether the core holds a PIN for the wallet. Since ticket 72 (D20, D22) PINs live in mw-auth only and mw-core-mock always sends false; consumers decide a first PIN from their own records (mw-auth auth.credential), not from this field.

kycLevel.description: The wallet's KYC level (FRS 7.1, ticket 94); optional for older producers.

birthYear.description: When the core has it (weak-PIN rule).
